#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

missing=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
    if ! grep -E '^[[:space:]]*permissions:' "$f" >/dev/null; then
        echo "Workflow file $f does not contain a 'permissions:' declaration." >&2
        missing=1
    fi
done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" \) 2>/dev/null || true)

if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
